description:
Pass Purchase

VALUE: Prepaid capacity at a lower effective per-call price — the difference between renting and owning the cost.

PRICE: $25.00 USDC per call.

HOW TO PAY: USDC on eip155:8453, exact scheme, to 0xc8fF67FAE72596478599EAAcfad8656fAe1113c8. Sign an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization for the exact amount and put it in the `X-PAYMENT` header, then retry the same call. An unpaid call returns a `payment_required` payload with the amount, asset, network and payTo already filled in. The `synthex-x402` SDK (PyPI and npm) does the 402 -> sign -> retry loop in one call.

calls_total.description: How many calls the pass buys. Default 1,000.
calls_total.title: Calls Total

route_scope.description: Which routes the pass covers. 'micro_le_0.25' = any live paid route priced at or below $0.25.
route_scope.title: Route Scope

ttl_days.description: How many days the pass is valid for. Default 30.
ttl_days.title: Ttl Days
